title: What is RAG and why do we need it?

cues.en: Welcome to the RAG section of this course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這門課的 RAG 章節。

cues.en: So, what is RAG and why do we need it?
cues.zh: RAG 是什麼？為什麼需要它？

cues.en: RAG is kind of difficult to understand, so I'm going to spend some quieter time here in PowerPoint to explain to you what it
cues.zh: RAG 比較難理解，所以在介紹元件和實際程式碼之前，先透過 PowerPoint，花一些時間解釋

cues.en: is, before we go into the components and actually some code.
cues.zh: 它的概念。

cues.en: So, what's RAG?
cues.zh: 那麼，什麼是 RAG？

cues.en: Well, RAG stands for Retrieval Augmented Generation, but that doesn't really make us any wiser, so
cues.zh: RAG 是 Retrieval Augmented Generation 的縮寫，也就是檢索增強生成；不過光知道名稱還不夠，

cues.en: let's see an example.
cues.zh: 來看一個例子。

cues.en: So, if we ask an LLM what is the capital of France, it can quite easily answer back that the capital of France is
cues.zh: 如果問 LLM「法國的首都是哪裡？」，它很容易就能回答，法國的首都是

cues.en: Paris.
cues.zh: 巴黎。

cues.en: So, this is an easy question, and we can give it very, very advanced questions like what is the Einstein-DeHaas effect?
cues.zh: 這是簡單的問題，也可以問更進階的，例如「愛因斯坦—德哈斯效應是什麼？」。

cues.en: I just randomly found that, and it's apparently something about spinning objects.
cues.zh: 我隨意找了這個問題，看起來和旋轉物體有關。

cues.en: Not important, but this feels like, oh, I'm really talking to an intelligent being here.
cues.zh: 重點不在這裡，但這種回答會讓你覺得，自己真的在和一個有智慧的存在對話。

cues.en: But then I can ask it, what is the guest Wi-Fi at the office?
cues.zh: 然而接著問「辦公室訪客 Wi-Fi 的密碼是什麼？」。

cues.en: And it doesn't know.
cues.zh: 它就不知道了。

cues.en: And of course it doesn't know, because in the world of knowledge there's different sections of
cues.zh: 當然不會知道，因為世界上的知識可以分成不同

cues.en: that.
cues.zh: 領域。

cues.en: There's the Internet, of course, and LLMs know the Internet.
cues.zh: 首先是網際網路，而 LLM 知道網路上的資訊。

cues.en: It's distilled, meaning that all side malware, the dark web and such things has been taken away, but else it knows kind of everything
cues.zh: 這些資訊經過整理，惡意內容、暗網等部分被排除，其餘則大致學習了網路上的

cues.en: on the Internet.
cues.zh: 各種知識。

cues.en: All depending on if you use a big model, it knows the entire thing in details.
cues.zh: 如果使用大型模型，對細節的掌握會比較完整；

cues.en: If you use smaller models, it's only the highlights.
cues.zh: 如果是小模型，可能就只有主要概念。

cues.en: But there's a bunch of other knowledge in the world.
cues.zh: 不過，世界上還有許多其他知識。

cues.en: The Internet is big, but all your personal data, your emails, your bank data, your documents and so on, despite them might being in
cues.zh: 網際網路很大，但你的私人資料，例如郵件、銀行資訊、文件等，即使放在

cues.en: a OneDrive or a Google Cloud or in Gmail or something, it's still not data that are publicly available.
cues.zh: OneDrive、Google Cloud 或 Gmail，也不代表它們是公開資料。

cues.en: So an AI, of course, don't know.
cues.zh: 所以 AI 當然不知道。

cues.en: And you probably can understand that you didn't want to know that already, because that could be medical information, that could be sensitive information in there.
cues.zh: 你應該也能理解，自己不會希望模型原本就知道這些，因為可能包含醫療資料或其他敏感資訊。

cues.en: So, of course, an LLM out of the box don't know.
cues.zh: 因此，LLM 開箱即用時，自然不會知道。

cues.en: In a similar manner, it doesn't know your company data, your documents, your contract with the clients and so on.
cues.zh: 同樣地，它也不知道公司的資料、文件，或與客戶簽訂的合約等等，

cues.en: Of course it shouldn't know.
cues.zh: 而且本來就不應該知道。

cues.en: It also, of course, don't know other people's data.
cues.zh: 它當然也不知道其他人的資料。

cues.en: You even don't know and can't get access to other companies, other people's private data.
cues.zh: 連你自己都不一定能存取別家公司、別人的私人資訊，

cues.en: So how should an LLM know?
cues.zh: LLM 又怎麼會知道？

cues.en: And then, of course, there's a bunch of offline data.
cues.zh: 此外還有許多離線資料。

cues.en: Despite me wanting to know something, it might be that it's only in a book in a different country that have that specific knowledge somewhere, because it hasn't been scanned yet, digitised
cues.zh: 就算我很想知道某件事，那個知識也可能只存在另一個國家的一本書裡，因為還沒被掃描，

cues.en: in any way.
cues.zh: 或以任何方式數位化。

cues.en: So there's a lot of data in the world, and an LLM has lots of it, but doesn't have all of it, of course.
cues.zh: 所以世界上有很多資料，LLM 擁有其中不少，但不可能全部都有。

cues.en: So RAG is the process of giving some of this extra data to the LLM so that it doesn't know on the fly.
cues.zh: RAG 就是在需要時，額外提供模型原本不知道的資料。

cues.en: So let's say that this box represented everything in the world I knew.
cues.zh: 假設這個方框代表我知道的全部資訊。

cues.en: I knew that my middle name was Rasmus, I knew my favourite colour was blue, I knew my parents had a dog called Mr.
cues.zh: 我知道自己的中間名是 Rasmus，最喜歡藍色，也知道父母養了一隻叫 Mr.

cues.en: Buttons, I knew the password to the guest Wi-Fi at the office is 42, I know I live in Denmark, I know John is in charge of support, and I know
cues.zh: Buttons 的狗；辦公室訪客 Wi-Fi 密碼是 42，我住在丹麥，John 負責客服，還知道

cues.en: my birthday is February 25th.
cues.zh: 我的生日是 2 月 25 日。

cues.en: If I knew all that, I could, in a prompt, or in what we know now
cues.zh: 如果知道這些，就能在提示詞，或我們現在知道的

cues.en: as instructions, give everything I know, and then ask what is the guest Wi-Fi password at the office.
cues.zh: Instructions 裡，把全部資訊提供給模型，再問辦公室的訪客 Wi-Fi 密碼。

cues.en: And then the AI would know, because it could shift to all of it and find that this one specific one is the part we need.
cues.zh: AI 就知道了，因為可以從這些資料中，找出回答所需的那一項。

cues.en: But this box, of course, is not everything I know.
cues.zh: 但這個方框當然不是我知道的全部事情。

cues.en: Everything I know is a lot of things, if we begin to count it up.
cues.zh: 如果真的列出來，我知道的事情其實非常多，

cues.en: So how could I give it everything I know?
cues.zh: 要怎麼把它們全交給模型呢？

cues.en: Well, some of it would be fairly easy to give.
cues.zh: 有些資訊很容易提供，

cues.en: It's just some raw text I have in various online documents and stuff.
cues.zh: 例如線上文件中的純文字。

cues.en: But there's also a lot of messy stuff in binary formats.
cues.zh: 但也有很多凌亂的二進位格式資料。

cues.en: For example, if I have a thousand images and they show different things on the places I have visited, I wouldn't be able to
cues.zh: 例如有一千張照片，記錄我去過的不同地方；如果資訊只有照片，

cues.en: ask my AI which countries have I visited, if it's only in images.
cues.zh: 就無法直接問 AI，我曾去過哪些國家。

cues.en: So I would need to give something to an AI and actually extract all that data from the images.
cues.zh: 必須先把照片交給某種 AI，從影像擷取出那些資料。

cues.en: So some of them are difficult to get to.
cues.zh: 所以有些資料比較難取得。

cues.en: And there's also things that I only have in my mind that are never written down.
cues.zh: 另外還有只存在腦海裡、從未寫下來的事情。

cues.en: I don't think I have any single document here that shows what my favourite colour is.
cues.zh: 我想沒有任何一份文件，記錄我最喜歡什麼顏色，

cues.en: That's only in my mind.
cues.zh: 這只在我腦中。

cues.en: And that is not something the AI would be able to be given.
cues.zh: 因此也無法直接把這項資料提供給 AI。

cues.en: And there's a bunch more.
cues.zh: 還有其他很多類似情況。

cues.en: And if we begin to tally up everything I know in terms of personal data, my company data, and so on, it would be
cues.zh: 如果把個人資料、公司資料等全部加起來，

cues.en: so much data that an AI would be information overloaded.
cues.zh: 資料量大到會讓 AI 資訊過載。

cues.en: Because what we're talking about here, if I gave it up front, we saw it before, this was fairly easy to give up front.
cues.zh: 剛才那個小方框，確實很容易事先完整提供，

cues.en: That would be like a hundred tokens or something like that.
cues.zh: 大概只有一百個 Token 左右。

cues.en: If we go here, there is actually a max to how much we can give.
cues.zh: 但實際上，我們能提供的資料量是有上限的。

cues.en: Just like if you place some text into a field, there's often a max limit on how big that field can be.
cues.zh: 就像把文字輸入欄位時，欄位通常會有長度限制。

cues.en: When it comes to the question we can give, the context window, as it's called, so this is the words that are being used.
cues.zh: 對 LLM 來說，這個限制叫做 Context Window，也就是上下文視窗。

cues.en: So if you hear the word context window, it's actually how much can you put into a prompt.
cues.zh: 如果聽到上下文視窗，指的就是能在提示詞裡放多少內容。

cues.en: And it varies from 128,000 for some of the big models to the really, really capable models is up to a million tokens.
cues.zh: 有些大型模型支援 128,000 個 Token，能力較強的模型甚至支援一百萬個。

cues.en: And turn that into pages of text, it's roughly between 500 and 2,000 pages of text.
cues.zh: 換成文字頁數，大約是五百到兩千頁。

cues.en: So Google is the one that are highest up right now, while ChatGPT is a bit further down, for example.
cues.zh: 目前 Google 的上限較高，ChatGPT 則相對低一些。

cues.en: But giving all this data comes as a cost.
cues.zh: 不過，傳入這些資料也會有代價，

cues.en: It comes as three different costs.
cues.zh: 大致有三種。

cues.en: First off, giving a million tokens, we have seen the prices.
cues.zh: 首先是費用，前面看過每百萬 Token 的價格。

cues.en: So if we need a big model and that, it costs, just to make that one prompt, one or two US dollars.
cues.zh: 如果使用大模型，一次送出這樣的提示詞，就可能需要一、兩美元。

cues.en: It also comes at the cost of speed.
cues.zh: 其次是速度。

cues.en: So if we give them all these million tokens and send this prompt, it will take quite a while to get back to us.
cues.zh: 把一百萬個 Token 一起送出，模型就要花不少時間才能回應。

cues.en: And if we give it everything among all these, let's say there was 10,000, a
cues.zh: 而且在所有資料中，假設有一萬筆，甚至

cues.en: million different entries in this context, one of them would say what the guest Wi-Fi password is.
cues.zh: 一百萬筆資訊，只有其中一筆記錄訪客 Wi-Fi 密碼，

cues.en: That's suddenly a needle in a haystack.
cues.zh: 就像大海撈針。

cues.en: So it might even not find it despite it being given because it has so much other data.
cues.zh: 即使答案已經提供，它也可能因為其他資料太多而找不到。

cues.en: But again, even if I filled up all this, that would not be nearly what I know in my mind.
cues.zh: 即使把上下文塞滿，也仍然遠遠不到我腦中全部的知識。

cues.en: And some of it will still be difficult to get because it's not even possible.
cues.zh: 有些資訊甚至根本無法取得，

cues.en: It can't read faults.
cues.zh: 因為模型不會讀心。

cues.en: So we need some kind of cert index for all this, everything I know.
cues.zh: 所以需要為這些我知道的資訊，建立某種搜尋索引。

cues.en: And of course, I need to curate what do I want to put into an AI.
cues.zh: 當然，也要先篩選哪些內容願意提供給 AI。

cues.en: I might not want to put my medical information, but I might want to put my financial information or the reverse.
cues.zh: 例如可能不想提供醫療資訊，但願意提供財務資訊，或剛好相反。

cues.en: But we need some kind of cert index for all this, everything I know.
cues.zh: 總之，需要為這些資料建立搜尋索引，

cues.en: And I need to put it into something a little like Google.
cues.zh: 放進一個有點像 Google 的系統。

cues.en: So when you go to Google and you search, it kind of knows the entire Internet and can find the right pages, but it's just the index of it.
cues.zh: Google 搜尋彷彿知道整個網際網路，能找出對應網頁，但核心是索引。

cues.en: It's not like it has all the information about every site, but it has enough information about the site in order to give it
cues.zh: 它不必在每次搜尋時讀取所有網站的全部資訊，而是保有足夠的網站資料，

cues.en: back to you as a search result.
cues.zh: 能將其列為搜尋結果。

cues.en: So we need to take our data and put it into a cert index.
cues.zh: 因此，要把自己的資料放進搜尋索引。

cues.en: And then we need to ask the question again, but instead of giving everything I know, meaning all this data, I need to make a search result on the fly.
cues.zh: 接著再次提問時，不是把全部資料都提供出去，而是即時先搜尋。

cues.en: So I need to search for Wi-Fi password office, for example, or just Wi-Fi password or however I find it.
cues.zh: 例如搜尋「Wi-Fi 密碼 辦公室」，或只是「Wi-Fi 密碼」，依照合適的查詢方式尋找。

cues.en: It's a little like going to Google and putting in the right words to give the best search result.
cues.zh: 就像到 Google 輸入合適的關鍵字，取得最好的搜尋結果。

cues.en: And if I do that, that search result will give back let's say among all this over here, three things back, that the Wi
cues.zh: 假設從全部資料中，搜尋回傳三筆結果，包括訪客 Wi-Fi

cues.en: -Fi guest password is 42, that my home password is Maverick123, and my last Wi-Fi bill, whatever that was in terms of money.
cues.zh: 密碼是 42、家中的密碼是 Maverick123，以及上次的 Wi-Fi 帳單金額。

cues.en: Because just searching for Wi-Fi password office could give the right things back, but also other things back.
cues.zh: 因為搜尋「Wi-Fi 密碼 辦公室」，可能找到正確內容，也可能帶回其他相關資料。

cues.en: It depends on how many search results I want to have back.
cues.zh: 這取決於想取得多少筆搜尋結果。

cues.en: In this case, if this was the most relevant one, and I said only one, it would have gone okay, but if I asked
cues.zh: 如果這筆最相關，而且只要求一筆，就能順利找到；但如果問的是

cues.en: for the home Wi-Fi and said only one, I would only have gotten this, and it wouldn't have gotten number two and number three here.
cues.zh: 家裡的 Wi-Fi，卻也只取一筆，就可能只拿到這筆，沒有取得第二筆、第三筆真正相關資訊。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm asking for three things, and these are the three most relevant just like when you make a Google search for the most relevant.
cues.zh: 所以這裡要求三筆，也就是最相關的三個結果，和 Google 搜尋排序的概念類似。

cues.en: And then the AI would be able to answer my question.
cues.zh: 接著 AI 就能回答問題。

cues.en: It would feel intelligent again, because despite it not having everything, it on the fly got the most relevant things, and among that, we
cues.zh: 它又顯得聰明了，因為雖然沒有全部資訊，卻能即時取得最相關的資料，而且其中

cues.en: were lucky enough that the answer was actually there and was able to ask, give it back to me.
cues.zh: 剛好包含答案，所以能把正確結果回傳給我。

cues.en: This is actually Rack, and what we are doing here is what is called embedding and ingestion of data into a vector store, which
cues.zh: 這就是 RAG。這裡把資料向量化並匯入向量儲存區的步驟，稱為 Embedding 與 Ingestion，

cues.en: is where we save Rack data, and whenever we make this request to the search index or the vector store, that's a Rack search
cues.zh: 向量儲存區用來存放 RAG 資料。每次向搜尋索引或向量儲存區送出請求，就是進行 RAG 檢索，

cues.en: where we at the top of our search query, augment the data with Rack data so
cues.zh: 再把檢索取得的資料，附加到原始查詢裡，

cues.en: the AI can answer.
cues.zh: 讓 AI 有足夠資訊回答。

cues.en: So this is actually Rack, what we have just seen.
cues.zh: 剛才看到的整個流程，就是 RAG。

cues.en: Now let's go into what the different components are so we can go in and see some code soon.
cues.zh: 接著看看有哪些元件，然後很快就能進入程式碼了。
